verdict_reason: In the June 2026 10-Q (not in the March 2026 10-Q), AbbVie began carrying the Skyrizi partner royalty on pipeline assets used in combination with Skyrizi, paid through 2044 at a 38% probability of approval; on the Q2 roll-forward this new tail is worth at most about $1.5B of present value (best estimate $1.0-1.5B, 4-5% of the $27.5B liability, about $0.56-0.85 a share of GAAP-only pre-tax charge), and its real economic weight is a roughly 16-18% royalty on any future Skyrizi-combination sales that management promotes as its next immunology leg and that no call or release has mentioned. | Neither skeptic refuted; both narrowed to the 2044 combination tail and dropped the 2037-extension headline (management said Skyrizi IP runs to 'mid-2030s and later'), the $27.5B-as-annual-drag framing and any 'raised the charge run-rate' language (H1 2026 3,905 < H1 2025 4,313). Still disputed after round 2: tail size, ~$3B (obviousness, materiality r1) vs ~$1.0-1.5B (materiality r2). I opened both pages. 10-Q 2026Q1 p.14: probability 100%/100%, years 2026-2037, Q1 FV change 2,387, payments 722, ending 27,039. 10-Q 2026Q2 p.15: probability 38%-100%, weighted 93%; years 2026-2044, weighted 2030; footnote (a) says inputs are 'weighted by the relative fair value'; six-month Additions are a dash (zero), FV change 3,905, payments 1,784, ending 27,495. Because Additions are zero, the tail can only have entered through Q2's FV change of 3,905-2,387 = $1,518M (p.33 confirms '$1.5 billion for the three months'). P.33 lists the Q2 drivers as higher estimated Skyrizi sales, passage of time and favorable combination trial results (all positive), partially offset by higher discount rates. Accretion alone is about 4.3%/4 x 27,039 = ~$0.29B; the discount-rate offset is at most ~$0.1-0.25B (lower end of the range moved only 4.1% to 4.2%; part of the 4.3% to 4.5% average rise is mix from the long tail itself). So tail <= 1,518 - ~290 + ~250 - (Skyrizi sales uplift > 0), about $1.5B at most. The literal footnote reading (w = (100-93)/(100-38) = 11%, ~$3B) would require the Skyrizi-only value to have fallen ~$1.5B in Q2, which contradicts p.33's 'higher estimated Skyrizi sales'. I settle for the roll-forward: it is an accounting identity, while the 93% is a rounded summary statistic whose weight basis is the only way to reconcile the two (pre-probability weights give ~4.6%, ~$1.3B). Confirmed: tail is new in Q2 2026, unsaid on any call, release or 8-K (obviousness skeptic's search). Materiality is medium: one-time GAAP charge ~2% of revenue, excluded from adjusted EPS, with an option-like margin drag through 2044. The J&J $753M peer contrast is level-vs-level against a mostly CVR book; drop it.
